Name: Kitty Ears and Tails
Author: Trudos
Description:
[b]Update for 1.1.0:[/b] This mod has been renamed from just Kitty Ears to Kitty Ears and Tails to reflect an important new update. It now comes with a tail. The tail and ears are both recolourable and are available as separate accessories, so you can pick and choose whether you want to wear one or the other, both simultaneously, or neither of them depending on your playthrough/your mood/the current phase of the moon. I hope to release updates with more ears and tails, and even add animations, in the future. But don't expect them before 2024.

---

Up until now there has been a shameful lack of cat ear mods for your farmer here on the nexus. I say until now, because I took it upon myself to fix that. You can now use the hand mirror to give yourself a pair of cute recolourable cat ears under the accessories tab. (I'm sorry, Fashion Sense doesn't add accessories to the character creation menu).

Currently it's just the one pair of smallish ears. Future plans for this mod include adding more ears, also tails. Maybe animations. As this is just a simple Fashion Sense content pack that follows best practices, it should be compatible with both Stardew 1.5.5 and all future versions. Also, like all Fashion Sense and Content Patcher mods, it's multiplayer friendly. Although your friends won't see them unless they download this too.  (So, uh, tell them to download this mod so they can see your neko transformation. Or don''t.)

Huge thank you to PeacefulEnd for making the Fashion Sense framework AND making the documentation so easy to read.
Also an enormous thank you to PathosChild for making SMAPI and ConcernedApe both for making Stardew Valley to begin with, and for being incredibly pro-mods. Not everyone is so comfortable with letting people change their game. Needless to say, this mod wouldn't be possible without all these wonderful people.

This mod is uploaded under a Creative Commons license. You can (obviously) download it, you can modify it, and you can share it with your friends and family. But you cannot upload this to another website (please link back here instead), you cannot claim it as your own, and you cannot sell it.

To anyone who's made it this far, thank you for reading, and I hope you enjoy the mod!
